extra._comment: Stagenet test fixtures only - stagenet XMR has no monetary value, so persisting these keys here is safe and deliberate (it lets the E2E test in e2e/README.md be re-run without regenerating wallets or re-funding from the faucet every time). Never do this with mainnet keys.
extra.role: Moneropay's own tenant under test, real spend capability recorded here like any other stagenet fixture wallet (there's no reason to withhold it - this is worthless stagenet XMR in source control, and full recovery/spendability is strictly more useful, e.g. sweeping funds back to `spender` via the CLI). Only view_key_hex/spend_pubkey_hex (the *public* spend key, derived locally from private_spend_key, never transmitted) are ever given to moneropay's own real connect API though - the e2e tests still only exercise it as a genuinely watch-only tenant, exactly as a real merchant's moneropay integration would be. private_spend_key was derived from the mnemonic below (already present, unused until now) via cli-wallet's own seed-derivation code and confirmed to reproduce this exact address and private_view_key.
